## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/event-doctrine-evaluation.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 7/7, full CI reports 118/118 across 15 files and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the 29 documented Prompt 16 plus Prompt 15 acceptance-reconciliation paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-16 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces world-event/doctrine/evaluation JSON envelopes with strict canonical owners, adds an opt-in deterministic fixture Event Director at source step 9, adds developer-only cause tracing and a cause-free player projection, persists explicit situations without implicit catastrophe, recomputes observational doctrine at source step 16, exposes Month-5 review eligibility without codification, and makes all six evaluation dimensions explicitly unavailable/unscored. It adds no production event dynamics, event effects, doctrine coefficients/profile choice, evaluation formula, overall score, forced crisis, UI, or narrative behavior.
